purpose: silver_nyc_weather is the cleaned hourly weather observation table for the three New York City airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) in the first half of 2013, derived from bronze.nyc_weather's 13014 rows. It types the landed DECIMAL(38,9) measures to their observed precision, converts the ISO-8601 time_hour text to a true timestamp, and drops Airbyte capture columns, so it can join to flight data on origin and observation hour.
usage: Read one row per origin per time_hour; use time_hour (TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, UTC) as the join and ordering key, and treat year, month, day, and hour as the decomposed parts of that same instant rather than independent facts. Consumers aggregating gust statistics must filter on is_wind_gust_reported or handle nulls explicitly, and should similarly expect missing pressure and wind_dir readings in any time-series average.
limitations: Coverage is partial: year has a single distinct value 2013.0 and month only 1.0 through 6.0, so this is half a year of data at three airports. wind_gust is null for 74.5505 percent of rows and pressure for 11.4953 percent, and no imputation was applied; wind_speed retains an implausible max of 1048.36058 that the cleanup had no evidence to correct. The declared grain of origin plus time_hour is inferred from distinct_count 3 and 4341 against 13014 rows and has not been measured for uniqueness in the warehouse.
